name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Gaia Sauna is considered to be amongst the Web’s top choices for high quality saunas – the luxury infrared saunas anyone can afford due to the fair prices for the units. It is in the quality of the saunas, the high performance customer service, 100% Red Western Cedar, latest Infrared Carbon Fiber heating technology, affordable prices and the ability to meet demands of any customer – all that make Gaia Saunas one of the best choices to work with when it comes to purchasing infrared sauna units.



Building units from Western Canadian Red Cedar makes it impossible for any toxins or chemicals to be passed to the customers in the process of using the sauna. Gaia Saunas care about customers and use only natural materials, minimizing the influence of any possible toxins and chemicals that might harm the unique natural experience of the infrared sauna sessions.



The construction of the sturdy hand crafted high quality units is also added by a modern elegant design that will bring a luxurious touch to any space. The specially crafted units are offered with a lifetime guarantee on all the wood craftsmanship and heaters – such is the trust in each unit Gaia Saunas provide. The confidence in the product is also backed up with a 30-day money back guarantee.
